meta.title: Gated Media Access: Restyle
meta.description: Gated Media Access with its components restyled by a separate plugin.
meta.author: gin0115

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$user      = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$container = ( new \Dice\Dice() )->addRule( '*', array( 'shared' => true ) );
$writer    = $container->create( \PinkCrab\Gated_Access\Access\Access_Writer::class );
$taxonomy  = $container->create( \PinkCrab\Gated_Access\Registration\Access_Taxonomy::class );

$group = wp_insert_term( 'Handbooks', 'gatedmedia_access' );

$handbook = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Member handbook', 'post_content' => 'Everything a member needs to know.', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) );
$briefing = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Quarterly briefing', 'post_content' => 'This quarter, in short.', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) );
$notes    = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Field notes', 'post_content' => 'Notes from the field.', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) );

wp_set_object_terms( $handbook, array( (int) $group['term_id'] ), 'gatedmedia_access' );

$upload = wp_upload_bits( 'price-list.pdf', null, "%PDF-1.4\n% Demo price list\n" );
$file   = wp_insert_attachment( array( 'post_title' => 'Price list', 'post_mime_type' => 'application/pdf', 'post_status' => 'inherit' ), $upload['file'] );

$writer->grant( $user->ID, 'group', $taxonomy->uuid_for( (int) $group['term_id'] ), null, 'demo', 'group' );
$writer->grant( $user->ID, 'post', (string) $briefing, 5, 'demo', 'briefing' );
$writer->grant( $user->ID, 'post', (string) $notes, 60, 'demo', 'notes' );
$writer->grant( $user->ID, 'file', (string) $file, null, 'demo', 'file' );

flush_rewrite_rules();
